import json
from pathlib import Path
import ida_bytes, ida_ua, ida_funcs, idautils, idc
rom=ida_bytes.get_bytes(0,0x100000)
out={'windows':{},'pointer_refs':{},'rtos_table':rom[0x4880:0x4a50].hex()}
for start,end in [(0x11110,0x11194),(0x128e0,0x12946),(0x6320,0x6390),(0xde62,0xdea8),
                  (0xdeb6,0xdefc),(0x3dd0,0x3fe4),(0x3fe4,0x40b0)]:
    lines=[]
    for ea in range(start,end,2):
        i=ida_ua.insn_t();s=ida_ua.decode_insn(i,ea)
        lines.append({'ea':hex(ea),'bytes':rom[ea:ea+2].hex(),'code':ida_bytes.is_code(ida_bytes.get_flags(ea)),
            'text':idc.generate_disasm_line(ea,idc.GENDSM_FORCE_CODE) if s else None})
    out['windows'][hex(start)]=lines
for value in [0x11130,0x11134,0x1112c,0xffff12d8,0x4880,0x48d8]:
    refs=[]
    for ea in range(0,len(rom)-3,4):
        if int.from_bytes(rom[ea:ea+4],'big')==value:
            refs.append({'ea':hex(ea),'xrefs':[{'from':hex(x.frm),'type':x.type} for x in idautils.XrefsTo(ea)]})
    out['pointer_refs'][hex(value)]=refs
p=Path('C:/Dev/Astra_A2WC511R/reports/local/ida/task_stack_audit.json')
p.write_text(json.dumps(out,indent=2),encoding='utf-8')
print('Task-stack windows and raw pool references exported to '+str(p))
